parsed.g: Display the list of issues in the keycloak/keycloak repository that have labels related to flaky-test
P_t: Navigated to the keycloak/keycloak repository issues page at http://172.185.52.29:8023/keycloak/keycloak/-/issues
R_t: Filter the issues list by the 'flaky-test' label (not just a text search) to display only issues with that label
parsed.e_t: The page is at the keycloak/keycloak issues list with URL http://172.185.52.29:8023/keycloak/keycloak/-/issues?search=flaky-test&sort=created_date&state=opened&first_page_size=20. The current filter is a text search for 'flaky-test' (search parameter), NOT a label filter. The page is rendering the issues list component via JavaScript (js-issues-list-root div). The DOM shows the page title as 'Issues · Keycloak / keycloak · GitLab' and the canonical URL confirms the search=flaky-test query parameter is active. The issues list is loaded via Vue/JavaScript components so the actual issue count is not visible in the static DOM.
C: The task requires filtering by label, not by text search — using search=flaky-test finds issues containing that text, not issues tagged with the flaky-test label
The correct approach is to use the label filter via URL parameter label_name[]=flaky-test or through the label dropdown in the filter UI

F_t.action: Typed 'label:"flaky-test"' into the search filter textbox at step 7
F_t.cause: The text input interpreted the typed string literally, resulting in a label filter token showing '~aky-test"' (corrupted — missing 'fl' prefix and containing a stray quote), which matched no issues. The DOM at step 8 showed the filter token as '~aky-test"' with 0 results.

F_t.action: Clicked the 'Clear' button at step 8 to reset filters
F_t.cause: Clicking Clear removed the corrupted label filter but did not apply the correct flaky-test label filter. The page showed 0 results for Open, Closed, and All tabs after clearing, indicating the clear action left an empty or residual filter state.

F_t.action: Typed 'flaky-test' into the search filter textbox at step 9
F_t.cause: This performs a text search (search=flaky-test) rather than a label filter. The ground-truth DOM confirms the URL is ?search=flaky-test&sort=created_date&state=opened, which is a keyword search not a label filter. This will not correctly filter by the flaky-test label.

K_t: The keycloak/keycloak repository issues page is at http://172.185.52.29:8023/keycloak/keycloak/-/issues
To filter by label in GitLab, the URL parameter should be label_name[]=flaky-test, e.g., http://172.185.52.29:8023/keycloak/keycloak/-/issues?label_name[]=flaky-test
Typing text into the search filter box creates a text search (search= parameter), not a label filter
The label filter UI requires using the label dropdown button or navigating directly via URL with label_name[] parameter
